title.narrative: Costa Rica: moving towards the sustainability of the HIV response with domestic financing 2018-2021 - Costa Rica (01-Jul-2018-30-Jun-2021)

description.narrative: Costa Rica, HIV, Humanist Institute for Co-operation with Developing Countries (Hivos) (HIVOS - HubLA)This program has the following goals: Strengthen civil society’s management ability and sustainability for coordination with the State and other movements.. Increase in domestic funding for the sustainable response to HIV.. Advance the transition of actions and facilities for the sustainability of a better legal, social and political environment to fully exercise human rights and gender equality of populations of MSM, transgender women and people with HIV.. Advance the transition of the combined prevention model as a part of the HIV care cascade for men who have sex with men and transgender women.. Improve the national information system for the availability of quality data disaggregated by key population.. The objectives of this program are: Increase domestic financing for civil society and key populations for the transition and sustainability of the HIV response.. Consolidate sustainable mechanisms for the protection, compliance and respect of human rights and gender equity of key populations and people living with HIV.. Support the strengthened model of combined prevention for MSM and transgender women and their national information system.
